# unifi_dashboards (Data Source)

The `unifi_dashboards` data source retrieves all dashboards configured on a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all dashboards configured on the site.
data "unifi_dashboards" "all" {}

output "dashboard_names" {
  value = [for d in data.unifi_dashboards.all.dashboards : d.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `dashboards` (Attributes List) The list of dashboards. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboards))

<a id="nestedatt--dashboards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dashboards`

Optional:

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

Read-Only:

- `controller_version` (String) The controller version the dashboard was authored against.
- `desc` (String) A free-form description of the dashboard.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is publicly visible.
- `modules` (Attributes List) The modules that make up the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboards--modules))
- `name` (String) The name of the dashboard.

### Nested Schema for `dashboards.modules`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String) The module configuration payload (opaque JSON string).
- `id` (String) The identifier of the module instance on the dashboard.
- `module_id` (String) The identifier of the module type.
